name: Super Mario Universe Deluxe
summary:
An all-new version of Super Mario Universe is here!

Super Mario Universe is a space-themed Super Mario World ROM hack that lets you chose the order in which you complete levels. There are 3 different planets that you need to explore in order to reach Bowser's Space Base and save Peach. Your job is to hit the Switch Palace at the end of each planet to be able to get in.
Compared to Super Mario Universe, Deluxe proportionally adds about as much content as Mario Kart 8 Deluxe did.
Super Mario Universe Deluxe fixes bugs, upgrades the game's visuals, adds quality of life improvements, and adds 2 new modes:
Frank's Lab - After activating a Switch Palace, Frank will open up a speedrun challenge based on that planet's stages!
Deep Space Mission - After saving Peach, a new mini-campaign opens up! Mario must travel deep into space to figure out what Bowser is up to this time.
